# Wrap up

Read the [operating rules](../../../docs/operating-rules.md) and
[ADO guide](../../../docs/ado.md).

Run in the authorized engagement or source workspace, never the vault.

1. Confirm the work scope, current dedicated-project ADO records, relevant
   SharePoint design versions, engagement drafts, source changes and
   actual checks performed. Distinguish observed results, failed checks,
   skipped checks and remaining uncertainty. Never invent completion/evidence.
2. Propose an exact ADO update batch for evidence and next action, plus any
   necessary decision/risk/deployment records using the actual process.
   Keep document authority in SharePoint and implementation details in GHE;
   do not paste entire designs into ADO. Confirm audience before posting links.
   Business rulings, risk acceptance, state/completion and live changes require
   explicit approval.
3. On approval, perform and read back each update. Report unsaved updates and
   blockers plainly; do not substitute a Markdown worklog. Capture recovery
   references on the relevant ADO item when authorized.
4. If transferring work, refresh the
   [handoff](../../../templates/build-handoff.md) only for changed contract or
   resume references; delivery state remains in ADO. Preserve unfinished local
   work. Do not commit, push or publish unless separately authorized.
   SharePoint edits/uploads also require scoped approval and saved-version
   verification. If the builder lacks ADO/document tools, return observed
   results to the authorized engagement session; do not claim remote saves.
5. Optionally propose a genuinely reusable anonymized lesson using
   [pattern guidance](../../../docs/standards-and-patterns.md). Ask before saving;
   shared standard promotion needs human PR review, not agent self-approval.
   The reusable vault may receive only that confirmed anonymized guidance,
   never project connection records, designs, handoffs or background inputs.

Return verified saved references, any unsaved result, and the next safe action.
Do not create timesheet, worklog or duplicate status registers.
